headline: Samsung says a third-party vendor for Samsung Ads North America was involved; a ransomware group says it posted 220MB.
summary: First build from Cybernews and DailySecu (both Tier 2, read Nov 22; Samsung gave each its statement) and Android Headlines (relays Cybernews). c001 vendor incident Confirmed on Samsung's own statement to two independent outlets; no Samsung page was found. c002 to c005 and c008 Reported (group claim and file contents as described by Cybernews; the group's post was not visited). c006 hack of Samsung's own systems and c007 vendor and method Not established. Privacy check done: no employees, officials or contacts named; employee details in the files are not repeated.
author: Research agent
